title: Tmax: A simple recipe for terminal agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.23321v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Terminal-using agents have quickly become a popular and important downstream application of language models (LMs). Despite their prevalence, relatively little academic work has examined RL-based training of these models, due to difficult benchmarks, a lack of data, and a lack of simple baseline recipes. We present TMax, an open RL recipe for terminal agents that brings small open models closer to the frontier. While simple, our recipe achieves 33% on Terminal-Bench 2.0 with only 9B parameters, outperforming much larger models from prior work. Our recipe first involves generating data using a novel taxonomy, combining difficulty control, personas, and verifier diversification, which allows us to cheaply generate large amounts of terminal environments for RL and SFT training. translated_title: TMax：面向终端智能体的简单配方
translated_abstract: 使用终端的智能体（terminal agents）已迅速成为语言模型（LM）一项热门且重要的下游应用。尽管其应用广泛，但由于基准测试难度大、数据匮乏以及缺少简单的基线配方，学术界对基于强化学习（RL）训练此类模型的研究相对较少。我们提出了 TMax，一个面向终端智能体的开源 RL 配方，使小型开源模型更接近前沿水平。尽管方法简单，我们的配方仅用 9B 参数就在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上取得了 33% 的成绩，超越了此前工作中规模大得多的模型。我们的配方首先使用一种新颖的分类法来生成数据，结合了难度控制、人物角色设定和验证器多样化，使我们能够低成本地为 RL 和 SFT 训练生成大量终端环境。随后，我们使用自建数据通过 RL 训练开源权重模型，采用简单的、仅基于最终结果的配方，并进行少量调整以提升训练稳定性。我们的配方适用于更多……（摘要截断）
tldr: TMax 提出一个简单的开源强化学习配方，通过新颖的数据生成分类法和仅基于结果的 RL 训练，使仅 9B 参数的小型开源模型在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上取得 33% 的成绩，超越了此前规模大得多的模型。
en_tdlr: TMax presents a simple open RL recipe for terminal agents that, via a novel data-generation taxonomy and outcome-only RL training, enables a 9B-parameter open model to achieve 33% on Terminal-Bench 2.0, outperforming much larger prior models.
